Chooser.question: Which gathering is this kiosk for?
Chooser.holdOne: Hold one to set the kiosk to it.
Chooser.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the calendar. Check the network, then reopen the kiosk.

Chooser.noPrinterPlugOneIn: No printer on this kiosk — plug one in, switch it on, then connect it.
Chooser.printerGuessedRoll: Printer connected — the roll had to be guessed. Print a test label and look at it.
Chooser.printerGuessedRollBare: Printer connected — the roll had to be guessed.
Chooser.nothingWasPicked: Nothing was picked from the browser’s list. Press {connect} and pick the QL — if it is not listed, plug it in and switch it on.

Confirm.checkedInTick: {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} checked in. Welcome!

Door.notThisGathering: If you are here for something else, please see a leader.
Door.installTitle: Install the kiosk app on this device
Door.installBody: To keep this kiosk on the home screen: Share → Add to Home Screen, then pair the installed app.

Grades.ordinalWithNoun: {grade, selectordinal, one {#st grade} two {#nd grade} few {#rd grade} other {#th grade}}

Pairing.title: Pair this kiosk
Pairing.howTo: In Tally, tap your name and choose <kiosk>Kiosk</kiosk>, then enter this code.
Pairing.noCode: Can’t reach Tally right now. Trying again shortly…
Pairing.stuck: This kiosk has its code, but the pairing isn’t completing. If a leader has already approved it, they should open Tally, tap their name and choose Check-in kiosk, which will say whether anything needs fixing.
Pairing.updated: Tally was updated, so this kiosk needs pairing once more. Any leader can do it.
Pairing.retired: This kiosk was retired in Tally at {time} and has not recorded anything since. Check children in from a leader’s phone until it is paired again.

Printer.adviceLidRollCutter: Check the lid, the roll and the cutter.
Printer.troubleHeld: Something else on this device is holding the printer.
Printer.troubleEditorLite: The printer is in Editor Lite mode.
Printer.adviceEditorLite: Hold the Editor Lite button until its light goes out.
Printer.troubleQuietAfterPrint: The printer went quiet after printing.
Printer.adviceNextLabel: If the next label does not come out, turn it off and on again.
Printer.adviceOffAndOn: Turn it off and on again.
Printer.troubleBusy: The printer is busy with a label.
Printer.troubleLabelFit: This label does not fit the media the kiosk is set to.
Printer.adviceLabelSize: Check the label size on this screen.
Printer.troubleNotFound: This kiosk is set up for a printer it cannot find.
Printer.troubleUnsupported: This browser cannot talk to a USB printer.
Printer.troubleStale: A label was skipped because it would have printed too late.
Printer.title: Label printer
Printer.nothingPrinted: Nothing has printed on this kiosk tonight.
Printer.modelHint: Filled in from the printer when it was connected. It has to match the machine on the shelf, so change it if it does not.
Printer.loadedLabelHint: What is in the printer now, sensed when it was connected. Events describe what the label says, never its size.
Printer.whichOnSpindle: The printer cannot tell these two apart. Which is on the spindle?
Printer.nothingWritten: Nothing has been written down yet.
Printer.copyBlocked: Copying is blocked on this device — select the text below instead.
Printer.checkPowerAndCable: Check its power and cable. A printer that lost power on an Android tablet has to be connected again from this screen.
Printer.looking: Looking for the printer this kiosk was set up with…
Printer.notConnected: The printer this kiosk was set up with is not connected.
Printer.noPrinter: No printer set up on this kiosk.
Printer.eventsCopied: Printer events copied to the clipboard
Printer.modelUnknown: The printer did not say which model it is — check that {model} is right.
Printer.mediaUnknown: {media} is loaded, and no roll this printer takes is that size.
Printer.mediaAmbiguous: {media} is loaded, and more than one roll is that size. Set to {label}.
Printer.connectedReadOff: Connected — model and roll read off the printer.
Printer.connectedGuessedRoll: Connected — the roll had to be guessed.
Printer.connectedGuessedModel: Connected — the model had to be guessed.
Printer.plugInFirst: Plug the printer into this tablet and switch it on first.
Printer.connectOpensWindow: Connecting opens a window from the browser listing the USB devices it can see — pick the QL.
Printer.mayConnectItself: It may connect on its own in a few seconds — or press Connect this printer again to hurry it.
Printer.troubleThenLookAgain: If it is plugged in and switched on and nothing changes, press Look again.
Printer.selectionCancelled: Nothing was picked from the browser’s list. Press Connect this printer again and choose the QL — if it is not listed, check it is plugged into this tablet and switched on.
Printer.stillOnPrinter: Nothing was picked from the browser’s list — this kiosk is still on the {model}.
Printer.testToBeSure: Print a test label to be sure, then go back and set the kiosk.
Printer.testSent: The test label has been sent — take it off the printer and check it.
Printer.stillWaiting: The kiosk is still waiting to be set — Back to the gatherings.
Printer.pickTheRoll: Look at the roll in the printer and pick it below, then print a test label — it should come out the full width with nothing cut off — and go back and set the kiosk.
Printer.rollPicked: Print a test label — it should come out the full width with nothing cut off — then go back and set the kiosk.
Printer.modelPending: Model and roll — read from the printer when it connects.
Printer.reprintNeedsPrinter: Connect the printer first to reprint a name tag.
Printer.checksNeedPrinter: Check and test need the printer connected. A reprint will try to reconnect first, and say if it could not.
Printer.autoPowerOff: In Brother’s Printer Setting Tool, set Auto Power Off to None. A printer that switches itself off has to be connected again from this screen.

Register.couldNotSave: Tally could not finish that just now. Try again, or see a leader.
Register.saveTakingLonger: Please check with a leader before you go. Your name tags have printed, but this is not finished.
Register.maxChildren: That is the most this screen can add. A leader can add the rest.
Register.welcomeLine: {names} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} checked in. Welcome!
Register.nextTime: Next time, just type <digits>{last4}</digits> — the last 4 digits of your phone.
Register.subtitleAllergies: Any allergies the leaders should know about?
Register.subtitlePhone: This is how you check in next time.

Search.enterAllFour: Enter all 4 digits of a phone number in your family.
Search.moreNames: More names than fit — keep typing.
Search.offerNotYours: Not your family? Register your child
Search.offerFirstTime: First time here? Register your child

Staff.changeEventKept: Children already checked in stay checked in, and attendance is not changed.
Staff.noPrinterHere: No printer on this kiosk — set one up below to print name tags here.
Staff.printerNeedsPrint: Printer needs attention — this may not print.
Staff.troubleLine: {trouble} — a name tag may not come out.
Staff.reprintNoRegisterChange: Nobody is checked in or out from this screen.
Staff.reprintInvitation: Tap a name to see what will print, then confirm. Nothing about attendance changes.
